paper.title_en: DEC Fill-ins, the Bartnik--Bray inner mass, and positive mass theorems with untrapped boundary
paper.abstract_en: Given a closed $(n-1)$-dimensional manifold equipped with prescribed spacetime Bartnik data, we ask when this can be realised as the boundary of a compact $n$-dimensional initial data set satisfying the dominant energy condition (DEC). This is a natural generalisation of the problem of non-negative scalar curvature fill-ins, where the boundary metric and mean curvature are prescribed. We give conditions on the Bartnik data that suffice to prove the existence of such DEC fill-ins with inner MOTS boundary, and give some applications of these fill-ins. Our first application of these is a lower bound on the Bartnik--Bray inner mass, which we slightly reformulate here to be a genuine spacetime definition. Our other applications include proving a positive mass theorem for spin initial data with boundary that need not be trapped, and a spacetime Penrose-like inequality that gives a positive lower bound on the mass of an initial data set with boundary in terms of its boundary Bartnik data assuming the spacetime Penrose inequality holds.

decision.title_zh: DEC填充、Bartnik--Bray内部质量与带非陷获边界的正质量定理
decision.abstract_zh: 给定一个紧致的$(n-1)$维流形并配以指定的时空Bartnik数据，我们研究何时可将其实现为一个紧致$n$维初始数据集的边界，且该初始数据集满足主导能量条件（DEC）。这是非负标量曲率填充问题的自然推广，其中边界度规与平均曲率被指定。我们给出Bartnik数据上的充分条件，以证明存在以内部MOTS为边界的此类DEC填充，并给出这些填充的一些应用。我们的第一个应用是由此得到Bartnik--Bray内部质量的一个下界，此处我们对其略作重新表述，使其成为一个真正的时空定义。我们的其他应用包括证明一个关于带边界自旋初始数据的正质量定理，该边界不必是陷获的；以及在假设时空Penrose不等式成立的前提下，证明一个类Penrose时空不等式，它用初始数据集的边界Bartnik数据给出其质量的正下界。
